summary: MCPB manifest exposes BEEHIIV_API_KEY as required user_config and wires it into the MCP server env.
reason: The packaged MCP server requires a Beehiiv bearer token; the generated manifest only exposed the optional client profile, leaving ordinary users no way to supply the key.
validated_outcome: manifest.json parses; server.mcp_config.env now maps BEEHIIV_API_KEY to user_config.beehiiv_api_key.
